title: "AMR_Visualization"
author: "Andrew"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tsviz)
library(ggplot2)
```

# Attempted All Sequence in One file

```{r}
data_all <- read.table("C:/Users/crawf/Downloads/AppCompHDS/Group_ProjectAMR/Results/AMRSeqResults.tsv", header = TRUE, sep = "\t")

ggplot(data = data_all, aes(y = interaction(Class, Subclass, sep = " - "))) + geom_bar(show.legend = TRUE) + labs(title = "First AMG Visual", x = "# Conting ID", y = "Class of Resistance") + theme_classic()


ggplot(data = data_all, aes(y = Class)) + geom_bar(show.legend = TRUE) + labs(title = "First AMG Visual", x = "# Conting ID", y = "Class of Resistance") + theme_classic()


```
